brief:
The United Nations called for greater protection of civilians in Gaza after Israeli air strikes damaged three UN warehouses on Sunday, with one sustaining significant harm, Middle East Eye reported. A UN spokesperson made the appeal during a Monday press conference.

The damaged facilities stored humanitarian supplies intended for distribution across the territory. The strikes occurred as Israeli military operations continued in Gaza, affecting infrastructure used by the international organization to deliver aid to civilians in the enclave.
